svg.title: A toolbox release moves its CI files to the new toolbox image: A toolbox version bump moves both of its CI files to the new toolbox image
svg.text: A toolbox release moves its CI files to the new toolbox
Scenario: A toolbox version bump moves both of its CI files to the new toolbox image

g.text: Then GitLab shows the version bump moving the full pipeline and the publication update job
Off camera, a throwaway copy of the toolbox, set to release 1.0.0 in its four version places so the picture never moves
when the toolbox releases. One fix commit lands on its main branch, then the version bump task release runs, without the
changelog. Before bumping, commitizen checks that both image lines hold 1.0.0, and refuses otherwise.
On screen, the bump commit as GitLab received it. The image line of .gitlab-ci.yml, the full pipeline, and the one of
.config/publication/gitlab-ci.yml, the publication update job, move from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1, together with VERSION and
